newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cable failure at $1.64 points to downside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cable failure at $1.64 points to downside.

text.p: Cable's failure to break above the $1.6400 level on Tuesday sets up a down move back to the the congestive support area around $1.6290-6300, technical analsyts said.
The $1.6400 area represents a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the move from $1.6545 and $1.6180 between April 1 and April 9.

"Cable failure at $1.64 and turn down in short term momentum indicators sets up a test of $1.6290," said Alan Dunne, technical analyst at BankAmerica. "Losses through there would trigger a slide towards $1.6175."
Analysts said the $1.6175 area represents the April 9 low point.

On sterling/mark the old ERM floor of 2.7780 is lending strong support to any downturn and is being reinforced as the 14 day RSI edges down, analysts said. The 14 day RSI was at 59 percent this morning compared with 68 a week ago.
Analysts said fresh upside tests are the most likely scenario for sterling/mark but they will tend to run into trouble at psychological resistance at 2.8000.
Above that, the April 4-1/2 year high of 2.8230 will prove a hard nut to crack, they added.
